notes.title: Uodate Feb.12th.2022
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made!
*Fixed a problem in which the shiny edges of attackers other than CZ-8408A were not displayed correctly.
＊Added "blue" and "brown" to the color tile colors that can be set in Construction.
＊Added an effect that changes the color of the screen border when the carrier is hit by a bullet.
＊Added a sound effect alert when the attacker's remaining armor drops below 3.

notes.title: Added one time missile pod and automatic fire for CZ type!
notes.notes:
The following updates were made today
・Added the "One Time Missile Pod" (CZ-8OP1), which adds 10 missiles to the missile pod when acquired, ignoring the maximum number of missiles.
The "One Time Missile Pod" (CZ-8OP1), which adds 10 missiles to the missile pod when acquired, ignores the maximum number of missiles available and automatically fires a series of missiles when the missile launch button is held down, similar to the original CZ model.

notes.title: Added new mission and new item!
notes.notes:
The following updates were made today.
New mission added
New items have been added.
　Granade pack that allows you to start a mission with 3 more grenades
　Missile Pod, which greatly increases the maximum number of missiles

notes.title: 26th.Jan,2022 update!
notes.notes:
* The images of TANK, AIRPLANE, FLYER, and MISSILE are now high-resolution.
(The range of expression has been expanded in mod. Initially, the images are drawn with four times the number of dots compared to the previous data.)
* The behavior of attackers has been adjusted.
* 4 new achievements have been added.

notes.notes: * Added screen settings.

notes.notes:

* The Rikishi Type (TKZ-5089A) now has an upgrade function, "Sumo Tackle"!
It will be saved after the upgrade parts are acquired, and can be used in future sorties with the Rikishi type!

* Added 3 achievements

notes.title: HKT-901A with extended functions!
notes.notes: When the HKT-901A acquires an upgrade item, it will now sway back in the air by typing → twice quickly. This gives the HKT-901A the ability to engage enemy projectiles in the air, which is extremely powerful.

notes.title: Official broadcast in 13rd.Jan
notes.notes:
Hover Attack 3671 has been updated almost every day since its release, and especially in the last few days, the attacker's control has been greatly improved. In this episode, we will focus on the basic jumping techniques, introduction of enhanced items, and future updates. We hope you enjoy it.

notes.notes: Adjusted the behavior when blowing hover while jumping.

notes.title: Update 10th.Jan.2022
notes.notes: [previewyoutube=QJL8-5oVDJY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] A new feature called "Decoy" has been implemented, which extends to the Cz-8410A by acquiring extension items. Two achievements have also been added.

notes.title: 9th.Jan.2022 Update!
notes.notes:
* CZ-8408A now has an enhanced ability called "Block Generation" that can be activated by pressing the N or R key.
　In addition to this, the attacker selection screen has been slightly modified to show the status of items acquired.

[previewyoutube=heviSOZSzrg;full][/previewyoutube].


The date in the upper right corner of the title screen no longer looks like the update date, but the date of the day...

notes.title: Update! 8th.Jan.2022
notes.notes:
* Adjusted the feel around the attacker's hover thrust.
* Adjusted the feel of the attacker's hover thrusts, making them dramatically easier to control.
Two new achievements have been added.

notes.title: Jan.5th.Update!
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made.
* The "A" key on the keyboard can now be used to shoot in the middle, and the "Q" key can now be used to shoot upwards.
* One more achievement has been added.
* The mission "Just start" has been adjusted.

notes.title: 4th.Jan.2022 Update!
notes.notes:
* Two new achievements have been added.
* Fixed a problem where the mission content was not reflected when the mode was switched during mission selection.

notes.title: Jan.3rd Update!
notes.notes:
・The new achievement "Mine sweeper" has been implemented.
・Sound settings are now saved.

notes.title: New Year Update #2
notes.notes:
I've added three new achievements (one of which is a secret)!

It's New Year's and there's nothing going on, it's cold and I don't feel like going outside, and I'm stuck at home, so I just keep working on my project...

notes.title: Jan.1st.2022 Update!
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made!
・Fixed grenades not being pad compatible (I must have left it off when I was fixing something).
・Adjusted the behavior of the mission select when switching modes.
・Fixed an issue where the mission name displayed at the start of the game in My Missions and User Missions was not displayed correctly.

notes.title: Just released!
notes.notes:
The game has been successfully released!
　In order to make the game as close to an ideal game as possible, we will be making a number of updates as usual until the end of March.
From now until the end of March, we will be making many updates as is customary for our products.

　We are also planning to have an official broadcast on January 4th. Please be sure to watch it as well.
